profiles.name: RISC-V RV32I
profiles.isa: RV32I base integer instruction set, version 2.1, except FENCE and EBREAK, without extensions

profiles.name: MIPS32 Release 2
profiles.isa: MIPS32 Release 2 integer subset, little-endian, with architectural branch delay slots; no Release 6 encodings

profiles.name: Arm AArch64 (A64)
profiles.isa: Armv8-A AArch64 state, A64 instruction set, integer subset without floating point, Advanced SIMD, or system registers

profiles.name: x86-64
profiles.isa: Intel 64 (x86-64) in 64-bit mode, a subset of the general-purpose integer instructions with 32-bit and 64-bit operand size

examples.source:
# Arithmetic with small and large constants.
def main(a, b):
    s = a + b
    d = a - b
    p = a * b
    big = 100000 + s
    print(s)
    print(d)
    print(p)
    return big - 4096

# Sum of the integers from 1 to n with a for loop.
def main(n):
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        total += i
    print(total)
    return total

examples.source:
# Sum and maximum of a fixed-length array.
def main():
    data = [12, -7, 30, 5, 18, -2, 9, 21]
    total = 0
    largest = data[0]
    for i in range(len(data)):
        total += data[i]
        if data[i] > largest:
            largest = data[i]
    print(total)
    print(largest)
    return largest

byteFields.name: REX
byteFields.text: REX prefix 46: 64-bit operand size not selected; gives access to r8 to r15 and to spl, bpl, sil, dil

bits.text: fixed pattern of a REX prefix

bits.name: B
bits.text: not decoded: with mod = 00, SIB base field 101 selects no base register

byteFields.name: opcode
byteFields.text: opcode 8B: mov; the reg operand is the destination

byteFields.name: ModR/M
byteFields.text: ModR/M 04: memory operand without a base register; the SIB base field 101 selects a 32-bit displacement

bits.name: mod
bits.text: memory operand without a base register; the SIB base field 101 selects a 32-bit displacement

byteFields.name: SIB
byteFields.text: SIB A5: no base register; a 32-bit displacement follows, index register r12 times 4

bits.name: base
bits.text: no base register; a 32-bit displacement follows
